title: Chapter 676
paragraphs: Chapter 676
Episode 173. Chasing the Sword (1)
"Eating a dish made by Jin himself... Ah! I just want to live here in Tikan like this. Right, Hedo?"
"Not at all, Miss."
"Why are you always so negative? I'm not liking what you've been doing lately."
"If you keep saying that, I can inform the family about your conduct. Then, even if there's a chance like today, you won't be able to meet the 12 knights."
"Huh, aren't you a piece of trash? Do you think being a eunuch suits that big body of yours?"
"It seems like a good combination. No one would look at my appearance and think I'm a eunuch, so it has a certain element of surprise and charm."
It's been a day since Hedo and Sandra came to Tikan.
The colleagues who watched them felt, like Jin, that they were a good pair (though the daughter was very eccentric).

"Hmm, no matter how I look at this, I don't understand this Jet. I can't understand why that great man can't move a muscle in front of Sandra Zipfel. It doesn't seem like he's been caught in a weakness."
"It is a strange relationship."

"The very existence of that man called Hedo is strange from the start, Valkas. We, the Ghost Squad, don't have any information on him, and neither does the Black King Party, right? Even our lord only found out about his existence after confronting him in the Sota Desert. How is it possible that we didn't know about such a figure?"
"It seems that Sir Chiron and Runcandel, the upper echelon of Zipfel, knew about him... but it's true he's a figure shrouded in many ways."
Tikan still knows very little about Hedo.
That he's Sandra of Zipfel's personal butler and the second-ranked butler of Zipfel, yet he receives the highest treatment in the family.
Hedo was in a position where he could request leave on the vague reason of 'personal affairs' during this time.
"And the words written on the sword that Valeria is looking at are also veiled."
Since yesterday, Valeria has been staying up all night looking at the records of the sword, 'Bale,' owned by Hedo.
As Bale was an item related to old Runcandel, its history was tampered with, as expected.
"Sir Hedo."
Valkas spoke on behalf of everyone to Hedo.
"You can call me just a tower keeper, leader of the Black King Party."
"I'm more comfortable referring to you as Sir. I called you because I was curious."
"What about?"
"I'm curious about your relationship with Sandra Zipfel."
"Are you curious about a servant serving their master?"

"Because you don't seem like a usual butler and master. According to Jin, you're loyal to Sandra Zipfel, not Zipfel. I'll prepare good liquor and cigarettes, can you tell me if there's any special story?"
Valkas was a surprisingly sociable character. Hedo also didn't seem too uncomfortable with Valkas's sudden approach.
"I always welcome good liquor and cigarettes, but there's no particular story."
"Don't say that, and tell me. Tikan is about to be paralyzed due to curiosity about you and Sandra Zipfel."
From his bosom, Valkas took out the highest grade Mila incense and extended it to Hedo. Hedo smelled the scent once and smiled in satisfaction.
"It's a quality that barely one bottle comes out a year across all Mila tobacco farms. Alright, I'll tell you."
Their companions perk up their ears.
However, the next moment, Hedo gave a very disappointing answer.

"There are often people who cherish their long-raised dogs or cats more than themselves. The reason I serve the young lady is no different. I've been watching her from when she was young, so it's just natural now."
"Are you comparing me to a pet?"
"If I had to put it into words, yes, Miss. Anyway, a small story compared to the cigarettes I've received. I hope you're not disappointed."
"Then...! For Zipfel...! How did you end up making an enemy?"
Jet carefully interrupted. He, too, pulled out a different type of high-quality Mila incense and offered it to Hedo.
He stole it from Kwal's drawer.
"There's no need to be so scared, Jet. I happened to join Zipfel while I was wandering in my youth. Hmm, this also has a very dignified scent."
"You seem to enjoy seeing the people of Tikan being played with, Tower Keeper."
Jin spoke, shrugging his shoulders.
"If you have any questions, ask me, if you have something to tantalize my palate."
"Do we really need to, when we naturally learn everything once we become one of us?"
If he asked Sandra, Jin could find out about Hedo's past at any time.
However, Jin didn't do that.
There was no need to reveal a past he was trying to hide, making a potential future ally uncomfortable.
His past wasn't such an important issue anyway.
What was important was going into the sixth tomb through Bale.

"And I'm more curious about the past of the sword you have than your past. I don't think I've told you yet, but the word 'Bale' written on the sword is the name of a person believed to be an ancient knight of Runcandel."
"Like the man I saw in the snow field? I had some idea."
"It's quite bitter for me that a servant of Zipfel has the sword of the knight. Well, apart from being a person of Zipfel, you, as the Tower Keeper, certainly deserve to possess such a sword."
"I didn't know you could flatter."
"I just told the truth. When I first met you, I was like, 'what kind of monster is this?'"
"That won't change my mind."
"One of the reasons why I should be good to you is also related to Sister Yona."
As soon as Sandra and Hedo arrived, Jin had asked for their help to find Yona.
"Didn't the lady agree to that problem yesterday?"
"Ho ho, don't worry. Sister-in-law, I will definitely rescue her."
"I trust Sandra. But I have a thought that you can report it to the top."
"I've been treated like a gossip twice. I can bring a contractor of truth to verify."
"I will trust and entrust it."
"It's not that you trust, but the moment something goes wrong with Yona Runcandel, you'll try to intimidate Miss Sandra, so I think you won't report it because I don't like it."
"I'm not so despicable either. But if the opponent acts despicably first, then there's nothing I can do."
"I don't mind being kidnapped."
At that moment in the conversation, Valeria left the lab. As always when such a thing happened, she had a pale face, but there was one difference from usual.
'Her eyes are shining quite brightly...?'
It was a look that Valeria showed only when she made a particularly great discovery. Jin recalled his past life at her look and smiled inwardly.
"Jin."
"Have you finished the record analysis?"
"Yes, come with me. I'll explain."
As Jin left, Sandra glared murderously at Valeria's back, and Hedo sighed and calmed her down.
"You seem excited. The harvest is bigger than expected, isn't it?"
"This sword holds the most intact record among the artifacts related to the ancient Runcandel that we have found so far."
"Didn't you say that the history of the sword was heavily manipulated?"
"I did say that, at first it really was. But this is the first time for me. As soon as my magic touched it, the history of this sword began to recover itself."
"The history is recovering itself?"
"Just like a dry forest swallowing rainwater, Hedo's sword began to revive the records within it as soon as Valeria's recording magic touched it.
Valeria had merely kept it in this state overnight, taking no special action to further restore the records.
"Yes, this sword perfectly contains a fragment of Runcandel from a thousand years ago. The condition is much better than the records we saw in Wontaramo Forest."
So far, Jin has never seen a 'complete record' of the old Runcandel. The records Jin saw were always partially or mostly damaged.
"Then it will show more than the recording devices left by Solderet."
"Of course. And maybe..."
Valeria paused and made eye contact with Jin.
"You may meet a living Runcandel in the tomb inside this sword."
"What...?"
Jin's eyes widened.

"I pondered why the manipulated history was so easily restored. Although there are parts naturally weakened over time, it wasn't enough to explain it. It wasn't because my record magic was superior either."
As Valeria unfolded her recording magic on Hedo's sword, she felt a vibrant force within the sword begin to resist the manipulation of history.
"So are you saying, a living knight inside is responding to your record magic, overcoming the manipulation of history?"

"It doesn't have to be a knight, but the possibility of someone surviving inside the sword is very high. Not as a guardian form, but as a truly living being. And if his mind is intact and he shows kindness to you, you could hear the stories of that time directly from him."
His heart rate sped up.
If he could listen to the dubious stories of ancient Runcandel directly, many of his lingering questions might be resolved.
The background of why Sildelei called Solderet a traitor at the first tomb, the reality of manipulated histories, Temar's death, the end of Runcandel of that time.
And the reason why Solderet hid the fact that he had chosen himself as a contractor a thousand years ago.
"What a surprising story. I didn't expect to find such a clue in the sword possessed by the Tower Keeper of Zipfel. Without that sword, you couldn't have entered the fifth tomb."
"Are you going to tell the Tower Keeper about this?"

"It seems best to tell him. He's a thorough person, and when we finish talking and go back, he'll probably ask to verify it through Yuria. Since he already mentioned Yuria, if he finds out that we lied then, he will absolutely not cooperate with us."
It wasn't a matter of simply refusing.
Hedo was the owner of the sword, and unless it was forcibly taken from him, it seemed better to tell him frankly.
Of course, Hedo is a man of Zipfel. Informing him of the existence of 'possibly living ancient Runcandel' was a very awkward thing to do, but there was no other way.
"Considering we can't kill the Tower Keeper now or take the sword from him, that seems better. When will you enter the tomb?"
"We have to start preparing to enter now. We don't know what will happen during the opening process, so it's better to try from outside."
